rows.text: The single biggest mistake a new pilot makes with Lord Xander is assuming you must hard-cast him for seven mana and keep him alive to win. In reality, Lord Xander is a devastating weapon when copied, sacrificed, and reanimated. Because the legend rule sends excess legendary copies to the graveyard, casting a clone like Phantasmal Image or Molten Duplication on Xander immediately triggers *both* his enter-the-battlefield ability (forcing an opponent to discard half their hand) AND his death ability (forcing an opponent to sacrifice half their nonland permanents) for as little as two mana. Furthermore, his attack trigger mills half a defending player's entire library in a single swing, instantly supercharging your reanimation engines or turning Bloodchief Ascension into a one-hit kill.

guide.title: The compact finish and late-game finishers

rows.name: Dualcaster Mage + Twinflame
rows.text: Infinite hasty attackers. Cast Twinflame targeting any creature, hold priority, and flash in Dualcaster Mage. Copy Twinflame targeting Dualcaster Mage, creating a token that copies Twinflame again. Repeat infinitely.

rows.name: Bloodchief Ascension + Mindcrank
rows.text: Infinite mill and life drain loop. Any single point of damage or card put into a graveyard triggers an inescapable lethal loop that mills all opponents and drains their life totals to zero.

rows.name: Bloodchief Ascension + Lord Xander, the Collector
rows.text: When Xander attacks, defending player mills half their library (30-45 cards), triggering Bloodchief Ascension 30-45 times for 60-90 direct life drain and an instant knockout.

rows.name: Torment of Hailfire
rows.text: The classic villain mana sink. Forces each opponent to lose 3 life, sacrifice a nonland permanent, or discard a card X times.
In accordance with Bracket 3 rules, two-card combos are reserved for turn 6 or later. Early turns focus on ramping, disrupting hands, and deploying Xander engines.

Look for opening hands with 3 lands, cheap mana acceleration (Sol Ring, Signets, Talismans), and an early enabler (Entomb, Sneak Attack, Waste Not, or Bloodchief Ascension).
Spend turns 1 through 3 deploying mana rocks and establishing taxing enchantments like Rhystic Study or Waste Not.
On turns 4 or 5, aim to cheat Lord Xander into play using Sneak Attack or Entomb into Reanimate, or cast him directly with mana rock ramp.
Once Xander is active, leverage cheap clones (Saw in Half, Phantasmal Image, Molten Duplication) to strip opponent hands and decimate their nonland permanents with legend-rule triggers.
On turn 6 or later, close the game using the Bloodchief Ascension + Mindcrank loop, the Dualcaster Mage combo, a massive Torment of Hailfire, or Rise of the Dark Realms.
